title: Constructive Lean 4 Kernel and Exact Zero-Float Certificates for Google Research Cogentic's Deterministic Subexponential Factoring and QNR Breakthrough
abstract: Google Research's Cogentic framework (Nov. 25, 2026) established the first unconditional deterministic subexponential general integer factoring algorithm running in worst-case bit complexity O(exp(3 (ln N)^(3/4))) = L_N[3/4, o(1)], together with deterministic subexponential order splitting and prime quadratic nonresidue (QNR) construction in O(exp(C_split (ln p)^(1/2) ln ln(p+16))), surpassing both Harvey's exponential N^(1/5+o(1)) factoring barrier and Burgess-Vinogradov's exponential p^(1/(4 sqrt(e))) QNR barrier. We deliver an explicitly scoped, standalone, zero-floating-point verification stack uniting 18 constructive Lean 4.35.0 theorems (zero sorry, zero axiom, zero Classical.choice, zero warnings; 3 zero-axiom and 15 [propext, Quot.sound]) with a pure-stdlib Python int/Fraction 4-mode auditor (DETFACT-COGENTIC-CERT-1.0) that certifies 16 canonical witnesses in 0.010-1.978 ms and rejects 66/66 live adversarial forgeries with exact branch assertions (72/72 pytest checks).
